overview: Series charting the movement to protect the heritage of the country, from its birth in the 19th century to the modern day.
title: Heritage! The Battle for Britain's Past

overview: From the world of The Boys comes Gen V, a thrilling new series set at America's only college for superheroes. These gifted students put their moral boundaries to the test, competing for the university's top ranking, and a chance to join The Seven, Vought International's elite superhero team. When the school's dark secrets come to light, they must decide what kind of heroes they want to become.
title: Gen V

overview: The Vampire Diaries is a supernatural drama/romance based around Elena Gilbert who falls in love with a 163 year old vampire. Based on a novel series by L.J. Smith.
title: The Vampire Diaries

overview: Contained within dusty storage drawers and dented metal cabinets of police stations everywhere, is a library of binders comprising detailed information about gruesome crimes. They may look like ordinary notebooks and folders, but each of them holds the plea of their victim waiting for the day that someone will finally catch their killer on Investigation Discovery's Murder Book.
title: Murder Book

overview: The anti-social Flodder family are living in a upscale suburban neighboorhood. They don't adjust to their environment, and keep on behaving like they're living on a trailer park. And the neighboorhood doesn't like it at all.
title: Flodder

overview: After getting divorced, Au Yiu-cho and Tang Lai-kuen operate two restaurants coincidentally called Yuet Tak House in Hong Kong and on the mainland respectively. They never have issues with each other. In 2022, Lai-kuen abruptly returns to Hong Kong to open a branch. She declares she wants to obtain the rights to the Yuet Tak House trademark through legal channels. The duo's little son Au Ka-kin signs up for Greater Bay Area Youth Entrepreneurship Competition. He runs into his elder brother Au Ka-him, who is appointed as an instructor, and also fellow competitor Cheung Loi. However, they familiarize with each other through conflict and strife, and they team up to create metaverse Yuet Tak House. Yuet Tak House physical store and its metaverse equivalent are both sued for copyright infringement, and Yiu-cho, Lai-kuen, Ka-kin and Ka-him face different hurdles. After all, they are related family members, so are they able to restore the initial bliss and tenderness to their relationship?
title: Communion

overview: In the year of 754 AD, the legend of the pagan warrior king, Redbad, is born, but so is a new weapon against his people: Christianity. Redbad must ultimately unite a Viking army powerful enough to defeat the seemingly invincible Franks
title: Redbad - The Legend

overview: Stoke Lords, Chad Kroeger and JT Parr, take their activism to the streets of Southern California to spread awareness on important issues. But when one of their causes accidentally leads to their cancellation, they use their activism to win back the good graces and trust of the culture.
title: Chad and JT Go Deep

overview: Yasin Gencer is a modest peddler who sells chickpeas and rice between Taksim and Tepebaşı. He lives with his lover Çiğdem, on the verge of opening the restaurant, they have been planning for a long time, and is at the very end of marketing his rice, which everyone loves to taste, with a special recipe heirloom from his family to wider masses and reaching their dreams. But in a way that befits Beyoğlu, one night after another, everything turns upside down. Unexpectedly, Yasin will find himself side by side with the darkest figures of Istanbul.
title: Seyyar

overview: Доблестный Руслан, отправившийся на поиски похищенной невесты, одолевает коварство, обман, злое колдовство - и, в конце концов, в жестоком бою побеждает Черномора...
title: Руслан и Людмила

overview: 27-year-old romance-free girl VS. Seta romance boy. Stability-oriented early marriage less wife VS. In translation mysterious chef. Beloved and addicted Papa Katsu Girls VS. Mysterious Yin-Yang Boys. A group image love story woven by 6 men and women who "can't get serious about love"!
title: Koi Nante, Honki de Yatte Dousuruno?

overview: Host Lily Du gathers together four guests to tell secrets, guess who they belong to, and enjoy a few drinks.
title: Dirty Laundry

overview: We the People with Judge Lauren Lake is a daily/strip one-hour syndicated court series.
title: We the People with Judge Lauren Lake

overview: In this newsroom, breaking means losing. Our reporters don't know what's about to be on the teleprompter, and every laugh is a point against them.
title: Breaking News: No Laugh Newsroom

overview: Bargain-blagger Joe Wilkinson and luxury-lover Katherine Ryan show us how to live the champagne lifestyle on a lemonade budget with some fantastically affordable getaways.
title: Joe and Katherine's Bargain Holidays

overview: Platform 7 follows Lisa who, after witnessing a cataclysmic event on platform 7 of a railway station, finds her own fragmented memory jogged to reveal a connection between her own life and that of the event she has just witnessed.
title: Platform 7

overview: A docuseries that pays homage to female pioneers in music who have stormed the stage, wielded their instruments, amplified their voices, and sung the soundtrack of our lives. In their own words, generations of iconic female artists discuss truth, defiance, artistic expression, hard-won success, and most importantly, the insights and tales behind their timeless music. The series features original interviews with Nancy Wilson, Shania Twain, Chaka Khan, Pat Benatar, Mavis Staples, Sheryl Crow, Sheila E., Macy Gray, Rickie Lee Jones, Norah Jones, Aimee Mann, Tori Amos, Kate Pierson, Tina Weymouth, St. Vincent, Jody Watley, and Nona Hendryx.
title: Women Who Rock

overview: World War II was marked by epic battles that decided the fate of nations and changed the course of history. From Germany's Blitzkrieg attacks on France, which launched the European campaign, to the Allied invasion of Berlin, which signaled its violent end, we bring these seminal conflicts to life through never-before-seen colorized combat footage. WWII Battles in Color puts you in the center of the action through rarely-scene films from the frontline, plus personal memoirs and oral histories from both sides of the battle lines.
title: WWII Battles in Color

overview: Rooney joins a sorority and meets a girl while at college.
title: Chicken Girls: College Years

overview: Follow Utah-based real estate investors, Doug Clark and Mike Baird in Flip Men, as they attempt to turn foreclosed property into profit. After a fierce daily bidding war at auction, the duo acquires homes sight unseen. When they first enter a newly purchased house, they never know what's behind the door: a biohazard, a meth lab, or an angry former tenant who just doesn't want to leave. Now they have to clean up the place, renovate it, stage it, get it to market, and flip it…fast. It's a race against time, because every day means thousands of dollars out of their pocket. They're the ultimate prospectors, and the stakes couldn't be higher.
title: Flip Men

overview: Welcome to Anonymously Yours, hosted by Teala Dunn! You've sent in your juiciest confessions, and each week Teala and a guest are going to read them, give advice, and dish on some of their own confessions.
title: Anonymously Yours

overview: Interview with My Kid is a brand new vodcast hosted by trans dad, Jesse Sullivan, and his 13 year-old nonbinary child, Arlo. Tune in each week as this father-kid duo welcomes a new guest for an open dialogue around issues like identity, pronouns, acceptance, and Gen Z vs. Millennial viewpoints.
title: Interview with My Kid | the Podcast

overview: East High is taken by storm when Troy, the star captain of the school's basketball team, and Gabriella, a brainy new student, connect on a level that's more than a school crush.
title: High School Musical

overview: About Amai Koichi who is good at baking and making sweets trying to help ikemens (good looking, handsome guys). If two people look into each other eyes for 8.2 seconds they will fall in love. Amai is attracted to men as he looks at them and falls for them. Each love interest per episode has a problem so Amai makes sweets/deserts for them in hopes to help them.
title: 8.2 Byo no Hosoku

overview: The adventures of a group of young motorcycle enthusiasts from a small village in the Ardèche.
title: Kick, Raoul, la moto, les jeunes et les autres

overview: Between six and eight people (at the start of the show 3 men and 3 women, then 1 man and 1 woman arrive during the show, then two eliminated), who have never met will have to get to know each other and why not to find love in a rather original way: in the dark.
title: L'Amour est aveugle

overview: Adrien is a 40 years old writer known as Mody who only wrote one successful novel and has been facing blank page syndrome ever since. He now is a ghost writer and has recently been hired by Albert, an old man dying from an uncurable disease and who will tell him everything about his life.
title: Les Papillons Noirs

overview: The show explores in depth a specific public health theme linked to current events. It broadcasts a documentary followed by patient testimonies and a debate with several specialists.
title: Enquête de santé

overview: Unhappy as a couple, Yann and Elsa leave their respective spouses to establish a friendship and be roomies. With their respective children who arrive every other week Yann and Elsa hope to find the perfect balance.
title: Platonique

overview: Follows a courageous woman's journey from servitude in England to the harsh life of Outport Newfoundland. Along the way she endures many hardships, including attempted rape and being abandoned by the father of her child.
title: Random Passage

overview: Titansgrave: The Ashes of Valkana is a gripping serialized story where Wil Wheaton takes a group of 4 celebrity role players and their characters through a life threatening adventure in a world far from our own where goblins wield laser rifles, dragons destroy hovercrafts, and great war machines plunder the land. The world of Valkana has been at peace, but that is about to taken from the land from an ancient evil that has begun to stir. Will the heroes be up for the challenge or will they be destroyed? Join Wil as he guides Aankia (Hank Green), Kiliel (Alison Haislip), Lemley (Laura Bailey), and S'Lethkk (Yuri Lowenthal) through this epic, yet troubled world…
title: Titansgrave: The Ashes of Valkana

overview: In this mini documentary series, Gérard Depardieu invites us to discover the culture of the art of living in the land of the Rising Sun.
title: Gérard de par le monde - Le Japon

overview: The series takes place during the night that Notre-Dame burned. It's about the destiny of men and women who have their own fire to put out. As the Paris firefighters try to stop the flames from spreading in the Cathedral, the show also follows characters being put through the wringer - they will have to fight each other, love each other, come across each other, hate each other, smile at or help each other - so that, in the end, they may have a chance to start all over again.
title: Notre-Dame, la part du feu

overview: 2025. Captain of the judicial police in Brest, Ludovic lost the love of his life, Mélanie, 27 years ago. The mother of their daughter Juliette died in what appeared to be an accident… But suddenly, thanks to a time rift that opens inside a reconstructed crime scene in virtual reality, they can communicate between 1998 and 2025! Ludovic warns Mélanie: she will die in 11 days! But saving her from certain death means that Ludovic risks losing his life in the present, the one he took so long to rebuild: his new wife, Parvana and their son Sam...
title: Vortex

overview: A mass grave is discovered on the Franco-German border. Investigating judge Camille Hartmann has lost her memory since an accident, but she feels that the murders are linked to her past. Erik Maes asks him to help him in his investigation...
title: Les Disparus de la Forêt-Noire

overview: With a whole host of celebrity guests, dance and trivia-based games, and unforgettable musical performances, That's My Jam promises to take popular and well known songs to the next level like never before.
title: That's My Jam

overview: Set during the flood of the millennium which hit Wrocław and its surroundings in 1997. When a flood wave approaches the capital of Lower Silesia, a decision is made - in order to save the city from the destructive element, the surrounding villages and fields have to be sacrificed. How will one decision affect the life of an entire community? The three main characters, faced with an extreme situation, will face events which will result in enormous destruction and the death of innocent people.
title: Wielka woda

overview: Salute Your Shorts is about a group of kids at summer camp. The camp is run by the heard-but-never-seen Dr. Kahn. The kids spend their time trying to harass the camp counselor, Kevin "Ug" Lee.
title: Salute Your Shorts

overview: Sasiwimol is an extremely successful director. She has a close, friend-like relationship with her teenage son Wang. What will she do when Wang experiences his first love with Inthawut, her old friend? Love, relationships, understanding, mother and son learning from each other in this era of changeability. A friendship will forever be altered.
title: 180 Degree Longitude Passes Through Us
Je ne suis pas un robot

overview: For more than twenty years, Diane de Poitiers was King Henri II's favorite. Despite her strong character and her legendary beauty, Diane is just another courtesan and her position remains fragile. And Henri's upcoming marriage to Catherine de Medici may jeopardize her dreams of domination. Diane will do anything to maintain her influence. But can her passion with Henri, twenty years younger than her, which is key to her power, really last forever?
title: Diane de Poitiers, la plus que reine

overview: From garbage trucks to power plants, giving viewers a rare behind-the-scenes look into the sprawling network of infrastructure systems that keep New York City breathing.
title: NYC Revealed

overview: Shaun Micallef's Brain Eisteddfod will feature teams of three year eleven students from schools across Australia to find the brightest of the bunch. Teams will have to show off their range of knowledge in a handful of categories like maths, art, foreign languages, music, all things Australiana and more.
title: Shaun Micallef's Brain Eisteddfod

overview: Behind the scenes of Las Vegas, the city in the Nevada desert that is famed for its gambling, showgirls and all-night parties. Featuring characters and stories that make Las Vegas one of the most hedonistic and fun-filled cities on earth, with access to casinos, wedding chapels, police and performers.
title: Billion Dollar Holiday City

overview: All That is an American live-action, sketch comedy-variety show that aired on the Nickelodeon cable television network featuring short comedic sketches and weekly musical guests. ork.
title: All That

overview: British people rebuilding abandoned historic settlements in Europe.
title: Help! We Bought a Village

overview: In a world where there seems to be little agreement on anything, there is one great unifier... the universal love of pizza. Best in Dough brings together pizza obsessed competitors from all walks of life to showcase their pizza slinging skills and battle it out for a cash prize. Fire up the oven, the first ever pizza competition is on!
title: Best in Dough

overview: Los Farad will introduce the audience to the Marbella of the 1980s through Oskar, a boy with dreams of opening up a gym and who, with the help of Sara Farad, ends up getting mixed with the fascinating world of the Costa del Sol, its jetsetting lifestyle, eccentricities, and geopolitics. This new world opens up to him thanks to the Farads, a family that offers him a future, but with the most unexpected of trades: arms trafficking.
title: Los Farad

overview: Truth is not what it seems; as the underworld of fashion, the billionaire class, and Jeffrey Epstein are revealed to all be inextricably intertwined with the rise and fall of this legendary brand.
title: Victoria's Secret: Angels and Demons

overview: Riptide follows Alison, whose life is plunged into despair when her new Australian husband vanishes after a morning surf. It quickly becomes obvious there is more to the story than meets the eye as she sets out to investigate his disappearance.
title: Riptide

overview: As South Korea's very first gay dating reality series, His Man brings together a group of eight hot, sexy, free and single gay men to a shared house where they are to live, interact and open up to each other in their quest for "true love".
title: His Man

overview: Merry Queer features the stories of queer couples on their "coming out" journeys, whether it be revealing their "unconventional" relationships to families, friends, or the world.
title: Merry Queer

overview: Fast-paced, action packed sketch comedy with Louise McCarthy and Gayle Telfer Stevens.
title: Stevens & McCarthy

overview: A group of Argentine documentarians spent three weeks in a natural park with no connection to civilization. When they return, they find that an epidemic has broken out around them, turning people into wild zombies.
title: Animalia

overview: A son's journey to find a woman from his father's past unearths a tapestry of secrets — and the untold history of their family's clove cigarette dynasty.
title: Gadis Kretek

overview: Takara belongs to the most prominent group in his class and is highly popular with the others, while Amagi is more quiet but is still bright, energetic and generally well-liked. Although they are classmates, the boys have no direct interaction with each other due to the differences in their peer groups, but in fact, both have surreptitiously become interested in the other. Realizing that their attraction may be love, Takara and Amagi decide to secretly date together without telling anyone else. However, Amagi, who is confused by Takara's mysterious lack of words and actions, is pushed to make an important decision.
title: Takara-kun & Amagi-kun

overview: In this university, there is a collective activity called BUDDYHERE that has been held for four years. It lasts for one semester and involves an appointed Budder who must take care of their assigned Buddy. The Budder are aware of who their Buddy is but not vice versa. The Buddy can even rate and guess the identity of their Budder. If guessed correctly, the Buddy gains the right to having the Budder care for them for the entire semester.
title: You Light Up My Life Again

overview: "Cold Case History" examines major murder cases in history and retells them as historical crime stories. Hundreds, even thousands of years later, these unsolved cases are being reopened using modern forensic technology. The exciting series takes viewers into worlds long gone. Each case takes them back to the time when the crime was committed. From there, a gripping criminal case unfolds. All relevant theories and clues about the case are presented; some of them turn out to be false leads - in the classic crime tradition. Experts and scientists reveal the twists and turns of the case step by step and make surprising discoveries along the way.
title: Cold Case Geschichte

overview: Experts investigate the crimes of Jack the Ripper by starting with victim Mary Ann 'Polly' Nichols, a casualty of Victorian prejudices as much as the killer
title: Jack the Ripper: 5 Victims

overview: When an imminent attack threatens India, an elite unit undertakes a mission that will test the limits of their courage and grit.
title: Shoorveer

overview: Dreamland is about secrets, lies, loves and aspirations within a family of four sisters. Set in the sun-drenched British seaside town of Margate, it is a dark comedic exploration of multi-generational female relationships, and their (somewhat dysfunctional) family dynamics. Eldest sister Trish is pregnant for the third time with her partner Spence. And this time, she's decided: it's going to be a girl. Her two sisters Clare and Leila rally around her with their mum and their Margate- legend nan, "manifesting" a little girl at Trish's ‘mani-festival'. But when their other sister, Mel, makes an unexpected reappearance back into their lives, her return threatens to destabilise the entire family. A knock on their door and their ‘Dreamland' is no more...
title: Dreamland

overview: Santiago Quiñones, a civil police officer has to solve two complicated cases; the emergence of a radicalized xenophobic group and, the murder of a drug dealer of Chinese origin, however, the most difficult case to solve is his own life.
title: Tira

overview: The story of patients and the caregivers of a hospice department. It is the story of people who dream of 'well-dying'.
title: If You Wish Upon Me

overview: A mystery thriller that happened in an ordinary village in which a missing case occurs on the day of a wild boar hunting and the secrets of the villagers surrounding the case are being unfolded one by one.
title: Hunted

overview: Little Women is a work that depicts the story of three sisters who have good friendship.
title: Little Women

overview: A work that deals with the story of a former prosecutor-turned-building owner who used to be called a monstrous genius and a former Miss Korea turned lawyer, surrounding the law office and 'law café'. Adapted from the web novel "Love According to Law" (법대로 사랑하라) written by No Seung Ah (노승아) and illustrated by Il Ri (일리).
title: The Law Cafe

overview: A joint response field log between the police who catch criminals and firefighters who catch fires. The police station and the fire station jointly respond to fierce scenes between crime, disasters and emergencies.
title: The First Responders

overview: A drama that depicts scandalous scandals of the nation's top law-abiding aristocrats dreaming of hereditary succession.
title: The Empire of Law

overview: Highlights from all the action at the 2022 Commonwealth games in Birmingham.
title: Tonight at the Games

overview: A comedy drama about five investors who are called "ants" in Korea. These are ordinary people, unrelated to each other, who meet in a mysterious investment club, learn life, friendship and love by playing on the stock exchange.
title: Stock Struck

overview: After unwittingly stealing money from a cartel, a cash-strapped professor finds the only way to save his broken family is by working as a drug courier.
title: A Model Family

overview: Zhou Lin Lin is one of those students who do well in some subjects, but fail with others. Thanks to a thorough curriculum compiled for her by the excellent student Fan Yu Ke, Lin Lin not only manages to catch up, but also to enroll in the best university in the country. It would seem that after the entrance exams, the paths of Zhou Lin Lin and Wang Yu Ke will diverge, but unexpectedly they were accepted to the same specialty at the university. The story of their relationship continues. Based on Po Po's novel "Peking University Students".
title: Binary Love

overview: This is an inspiring story about Lin Zi Yan, who became sensitive and lonely after his eyes were damaged, and Xia Yu, a bright and positive girl who was his housekeeper. They healed each other and grew up together. Lin Ziyang was pessimistic and withdrawn due to eye disease, gradually regained his passion for life and career, as he was influenced by Xia Yu's optimistic attitude. Xia Yu, despite the difficult relationship with her family, was always dynamic in the face of life's difficulties. There is no life-long probation period, so we shouldn't limit our options, she thought.
title: Dear Probationary Girlfriend

overview: Kashiwazaki Yu has been dating her boyfriend Naoki for 7 years, and they have been living together for 5 of them. Romance has long gone out of the relationship and even Yu Naoki's birthday is more interested in his new game than her holiday. And Naoki doesn't seem to be thinking about the wedding at all. An angry Yu leaves the house and immediately meets her ex-boyfriend from Fukami High School. Yu finds himself in a love triangle. What will the girl choose — the current guy who treats her more like a mother, or the former, who still has tender feelings for her and considers her special?
title: Hanayome Miman Escape

overview: One summer day, a young man, Kita (Shigeoka Milking), who has no money and nowhere to live, tried to commit suicide, but could not take the last step. Hesitating between life and death, he saw a program about gourmet food on TV, and realizing that he had never eaten crabs in his life, he decided that "on my last day on this Earth, I will eat crabs." However, China needs money to implement its plan. After following a woman Yukieda Ayame (Iriyama Noriko), who lives in a prestigious area, he made his way to her house and demanded money, however ... everything did not go according to plan.
title: Yukionna to Kani wo Kuu

overview: When you rescue the man who annoyed you the most and he wakes up with amnesia, what kind of relationship can you expect? Overbearing CEO Ningcheng Ming has a reputation as a "professor from hell". After a mysterious car accident, he was saved by Li Qian, whom he had not seen for many years. They were enemies. Once she was a witty student, and now she is a versatile secretary.
title: The Trick of Life and Love

overview: Legends of the Hidden Temple is an action-adventure game show for children. The show centers around a Temple that is filled with lost treasures protected by mysterious Mayan Temple Guards. Kirk Fogg hosts and serves as the teams' guide. Six teams of two children (one boy and one girl) compete to retrieve one of the historical artifacts in the Temple by performing physical stunts and answering questions based on history, mythology, and geography. After three elimination rounds, only one team remains, who then earns the right to go through the Temple to retrieve the artifact within three minutes and win a grand prize.
title: Legends of the Hidden Temple

overview: Host John Catucci (You Gotta Eat Here!) takes viewers on a one-of-a-kind food adventure across North America as he checks buzz-worthy, crazy, delicious food off his bucket list. In each episode, John visits the restaurants behind these must-eat meals and hits the kitchen to lend a helping hand and learn how the chefs make their mind-blowing creations. We're talking sticky, saucy Missouri-style ribs, Nova Scotia's straight from the sea, succulent lobster, Vancouver B.C.'s crispy, out of this world fried chicken, and Irvine, Calf.'s overloaded spaghetti grilled cheese you have to see to believe. John's setting out to eat each and every drool-worthy dish, and check them off his Big Food Bucket List.
title: Big Food Bucket List

overview: A drama about single life helpers who become wives to single men who need wives to attend meetings. Tells the story of a helper service that provides wives to single people needing partners to take to gatherings for married couples and school reunions. The story portrays Choi Sang Eun as she gets entangled with Jung Ji Ho, who is on a long-term exclusive contract for Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, and Kang Hae Jin, who signs a new contract for Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays. Choi Sang Eun, is a woman possessing many great qualities and virtues. As the perfect partner, she chooses a career of helping single men who don't want to get married instead of getting married herself. Jung Ji Ho who has been in a long-term contract with Choi Sang Eun for Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays for his fifth year. In addition for the reason behind his contract being a secret, Jung Ji Ho is a mysterious character whose occupation, hobbies, and personality are also shrouded in a veil of secrecy. And Kang Hae Jin, a rich heir as the family's youngest son and Hallyu star. Kang Hae Jin is Choi Sang Eun's newest client for Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, and he will cause a great storm in her heart.
title: Love in Contract

overview: It was only a matter of time - Join costars Tom Welling (Clark Kent) and Michael Rosenbaum (Lex Luthor) as they dissect a new episode every week from one of the greatest shows of all time, Smallville.
title: Talk Ville

overview: A story about K-first daughter Kim Tae-joo and top star K-first son Lee Sang-joon seeking happiness.
title: Three Siblings Bravely

overview: A sports drama about a former national athlete who quit sports after an accident helps players in the slumps, heal retired old veterans and plays a real game against the absurd world of winner-take-all. A sports drama about a former national athlete who quits sports after causing a scandal and becomes a mental coach to help former professional athletes who have retired and current athletes who have fallen into a slump. Je Gal Gil is a former national Taekwondo athlete who is known for his hard work and dorky charms. After he causes an unprecedented accident in the athlete's village, Je Gal Gil is permanently expelled and coined the unlucky Taekwondo prodigy. Once he overcomes his past trauma and regains his mental health, Je Gal Gil returns to the athlete's village as a mental coach. Cha Ga Eul is a former world-class short track speed skating gold medalist who has fallen into a slump. With her pretty poker face, she's known as the up-and-coming "Ice Princess," but she faces the danger of fading out when she falls into a slump. Unable to confide in anyone, Cha Ga Eul begins to beat herself up until she meets mental coach Je Gal Gil. Gu Tae Man is the director of the Human Rights Center in the Korean Olympic Committee. The former Taekwondo Olympic gold medalist has a strong desire for power and is the reason Je Gal Gil's life was transformed overnight. With the belief that anything can be covered as long as he is No. 1, Gu Tae Min does everything he can for the top position. Park Seung Ha is a part of the mental health support team in the athlete's village. She is the perfect example of "a kind daughter who was raised well" but endures an unexpected hardship after meeting Je Gal Gil as her first patient. Park Seung Ha ends up leaving the hospital and applying to the athlete's village instead where she surprisingly reunites with Je Gal Gil, this time as advisor partners.
title: Mental Coach Je Gal Gil

overview: After the slaughter at Great Spirits ranch one or more killers remains on the loose, unbeknownst to a gathering of women at The Wellness Retreat and healing Spa Ranch in Big Sur. A private and secluded spa in the mountains along the coast of California, TWRHSR, as it is affectionately known, is an gathering place where small groups of women (and their GBFs) of all ages and ilks gather to reclaim their relationship with mother earth and their own vaginas. A new group of arrivals enjoy a beautiful first day in the sun before things turn dark with a storm of epic proportions. The storm causes the only bridge out of town to collapse and the communications to be short-circuited. which would not have given anyone pause if it hadn't been for the dead body in the hot tub. While the first body could easily have been an accident, the second sends off warning bells in staff and guest alike. But no one can leave and help can't come until communication is restored and the bridge out of town is repaired. It will be a long 5 days and the body count will rise until help arrives to save those that remain.
title: Crazy Bitches

overview: This is a story about a young, promising woman An Yu, the chairman of Haowu Group. She had everything a young woman could dream of: a happy family and a career. But a car accident ruined everything. She was in a coma for two years. After coming out of a coma, she found out about the betrayal of a loved one. Recovering from the shock, Han Yu decided to go to work to calm the pain. She accidentally meets Shao Mo Li. After getting acquainted with Han Yu's business and her ideas, the young man decided to help her and jointly engage in this business. After going through all the difficulties, they managed to bring their mutual business to the highest level. Working together helped them not only to get closer, but also to fall in love with each other.
title: To Be a Brave One

overview: When Sana was only 23 years old on her sleeve, she co-founded the startup Dream Pony. The main product of the company was an educational application, and Sana dreamed that her application would become popular all over the world. Now the girl is already 26, and her startup has been around for three years. At first, things were going very well, but now the company is in stagnation. Because of this, the sleeves are constantly worried. In addition, she was trapped in unrequited love because of her feelings for Suzuki Ko, the co-founder of Dream Pony, who knows nothing about the feelings of his colleague. One day, a middle-aged man who is Satoshi gets a job at Dream Pony. Before that, who worked in a traditional Japanese company, and it's hard for him to get used to the "modern" way of doing business. And on the sleeves, in whose subordination the man turned out to be, I am not happy with such cooperation. However, it soon became clear that Kotori could share his knowledge based on wisdom and experience.
title: Yunikon ni Notte

overview: My Strange Criminal Addiction reveals what happens when bizarre compulsions spin out of control and push people into a life of crime. From a lewd subway commuter to a diaper-wearing man, or a urine drinker to a toe sucker, first-hand accounts of these true crime tales plunges viewers into a world where strange addictions took an illegal turn. Dr. Mike Dow, addiction specialist and expert in the fields of relationships, food, and behavior, explains how these unhealthy habits turned to uncontrollable addictions and helps viewers understand the triggers for these compulsive behaviors. With the perpetrators telling their own stories of how they plunged so deep into darkness, some appear on screen or disguised to conceal their identity while others speak to us from their jail cells.
title: My Strange Criminal Addiction

overview: Portrait Artist of the Year is hosted by UK TV personalities Joan Bakewell and Frank Skinner; an esteemed group of judges travel across the Europe in search of a new star in the art world. Each episode features a regional competition where artists are shortlisted and challenged to produce a portrait of one of three famous sitters. At the end of each round, the judges select an artist to go to the semifinal. The finalists will have their work displayed at the world-famous National Portrait Gallery in London and the winner will receive a £10,000 commission to paint a portrait which will become part of the permanent collection at the British Library.
title: Portrait Artist of the Year
